patch.description: Partially updates a wastage case. get.description: Tenant-scoped summary of energy, water, gas, emissions (Scope 1 gas + Scope 2 grid electricity), and food wastage across a period. Defaults to January of the current year through the last full month. granularity is month (default), quarter or year; readings are monthly totals, so week/day are rejected with 400. Includes time series, totals, deltas vs previous period, meter coverage, and silent_meters (active meters with no readings in the period). With groupBy=building, also by_building: per-building electricity, water, gas and emissions (they add up to the campus totals), electricity change vs the previous period and vs the same months last year, meters reporting, and silent or faulty meters.

Status changes follow the approval gate: only the Organization Admin moves proposed→approved|rejected (optional decision_note, sent to the proposer); the Sustainability Officer (or Admin) moves approved→in-progress→completed. Anything else is 403. With onsite_work: approved→in-progress sends one job per technician type in teams into dispatch, all at once, each due on the target date (400 if that date has passed); in-progress→completed is refused (409) while any of its jobs is open.

get.description: Measured saving since start_date: each month against the same month a year earlier on the initiative's meters (meter_ids, else its metric's meters in building_ids, else the whole organisation), counting only months with readings on both sides. Returns months_compared, actual_saving_to_date, expected_to_date (expected_saving pro rata), on_track and a green/amber/red rating. measurable=false without a metric or start date.

post.description: For an in-progress initiative with on-site work: one of its closed jobs was not done properly. Creates a new job for the same technician type through normal dispatch, with the reason (shown to the technician) and finish_by (YYYY-MM-DD, today or later) as its finish date. The initiative cannot be completed until that job is closed too. 400 if the job is still open, the reason is under 3 characters or the date is missing or past.

201.description: Rework job created; returns the initiative with its jobs.

400.description: Job still open, initiative not in progress, or bad reason/date.

404.description: Initiative or job not found.

patch.description: Moves a completed or rejected initiative into Archives without deleting it. Any other status returns 400. Archiving again keeps the original archived_at.

400.description: Initiative is not completed or rejected.

404.description: Not found.

post.description: Cut a metric (energy_kwh, water_kl, gas_m3, emissions_kg) by reduction_pct against a finished baseline period by a future deadline month, for the organisation or some buildings. 409.description: An open target already covers this metric and scope.

get.description: Every target in the organisation, newest first, each with a plain-language summary and its progress. Active targets whose deadline month has finished are closed as met or missed first.
